d: So, everyone knows Istanbul, Cappadocia, Antalya, and Izmir, but there's a whole lot more to Turkey than just the tourist traps. I recently went on a trip and discovered this awesome little village called Otluk. It's super authentic and gave me a real taste of Turkish culture. In my latest vlog, I'm taking you on a journey from Denizli to Pamukkale, which is one of Turkey's most famous attractions.
